_note: Texts for Levie's Act 1 puzzles. Log lines <=41 chars. Barks are speaker/text/face/tier like barks.json and follow bark_rules.json. When each one fires: story/triggers_act1.json.

floor2_vents.lever_pulled_left: Air roars. Stores drain. Cistern floods.
floor2_vents.lever_pulled_right: Air roars. Cistern drains. Stores flood.

barks.speaker: brannoc
barks.text: Air's a river too. You just steer it.

barks.speaker: mags
barks.text: Great. We drowned the one thing we wanted.

floor3_offering.bowl_examine: A stone bowl, black with old soot.
floor3_offering.bowl_lantern: The bowl wants fire it can keep.
floor3_offering.bowl_lit: The water in the doorway parts.
floor3_offering.room_dark: Behind you, the mess hall goes dark.

barks.speaker: wren
barks.text: An offering bowl. They fed it fire.

barks.speaker: ilsevar
barks.text: It took the torch. It liked the torch.

barks.speaker: mags
barks.text: So we're doing the pact now. Lovely.

carving: I am given and never returned.
I am small, then I am all.
answer_alternatives: Wren's lantern held to the altar also works

barks.speaker: mags
barks.text: A riddle door. Dwarves have no fun.

barks.speaker: brannoc
barks.text: We have plenty. It's just carved.

barks.speaker: ilsevar
barks.text: What does the water always want?

wall_carving: The drill of the Ashmantle guard:
floor4_drill_tiles.step_off_hammer: The hammer tile springs back up.
floor4_drill_tiles.step_wrong: The tiles reset with a grinding sigh.

barks.speaker: brannoc
barks.text: Two hammers, lass. Dwarves always hit twice.

barks.speaker: mags
barks.text: I'd salute, but my arms are tired.
